provenance: Lane split derived by the orchestrator applying the Stage-2 decision-agent's documented routing rule (detect-vs-hunt by detection feasibility: low=hunt, medium/high=detect) because the decision-agent run was interrupted by a session rate limit. Partition validated to cover the Stage-1 seed exactly with no overlap/dup; all ids verified present in the CI's bundled ATT&CK dataset.

detection_candidates.rationale: medium — CVE-2019-0604 exploitation is detectable via SharePoint/IIS request patterns, WAF/IDS signatures, and vulnerable-version telemetry, though n-day exploitation of an exposed server may precede monitoring
medium — new .aspx files in web-root paths and IIS worker (w3wp.exe) spawning child processes are strong web-shell signals, though a long-dormant shell may evade point-in-time review
medium — scheduled-task creation (Event ID 4698 / Task Scheduler operational log) referencing unusual binaries or user-writable paths is detectable

detection_candidates.technique_name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — new startup/Run-key entries or Startup-folder scripts pointing at binaries in ProgramData are detectable via autostart and registry-write telemetry

detection_candidates.technique_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — batch-driven cmd.exe issuing vssadmin/taskkill/reg-add commands in quick succession is a detectable destructive-staging pattern via process-command-line telemetry
medium — PowerShell script-block logging (4104) and AMSI telemetry detect follow-on command execution, though usage is easily blended with admin activity

detection_candidates.technique_name: Obfuscated Files or Information: Encrypted/Encoded File
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — Base64-heavy .aspx content and large encoded blobs in web files are detectable via web-content inspection and entropy analysis
medium — runtime decode-and-load behavior (Assembly.Load of decoded bytes) is detectable via .NET/CLR and script-block telemetry

detection_candidates.technique_name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — Defender tamper events, service/registry changes disabling real-time protection, and execution of a known disable_defender binary are detectable via EDR tamper-protection and Defender operational logs
medium — scripted registry writes to the Wallpaper value followed by a forced desktop refresh across many hosts is an anomalous, detectable pattern
medium — LSASS access, SAM/registry-hive dumping, and credential-theft tooling are detectable via process-access (Sysmon EID 10) and command-line telemetry
medium — internal horizontal port-scan connection fan-out and known scanner-binary execution are detectable, though scan tools are easily renamed
medium — host-enumeration bursts across a subnet are detectable but blend with legitimate administration
medium — RDP from atypical internal hosts (e.g. a print server originating outbound RDP) and lateral-RDP graph anomalies are detectable via logon (4624 type 10) analytics
medium — payload copies to ADMIN$/C$ shares followed by remote execution across many hosts are detectable via SMB write and remote-create telemetry
medium — executable/script copies between internal hosts shortly before execution are detectable via file-write and network-share telemetry

detection_candidates.technique_name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — installation/load of the EldoS RawDisk driver (rwdsk.sys) and new kernel-service creation (Event ID 7045 / Sysmon driver-load EID 6) are detectable, and the driver hash is a known IOC
medium — POST requests to an unusual .aspx endpoint followed by the web server initiating outbound sockets to arbitrary IP:port is a detectable web-shell C2 pattern
medium — the web server or a beaconing host writing new executables to disk shortly after inbound C2 is detectable via network-to-file-create correlation
medium — a scripted taskkill /f loop against a broad process list immediately before mass file changes is a high-value, detectable ransomware/wiper precursor
high — vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet is a discrete, high-fidelity, well-covered destructive precursor and one of the most reliable early-warning signals

medium — a user-mode process acquiring a raw \\.\PhysicalDrive handle via the EldoS driver and issuing large sequential writes is a rare, high-fidelity destructive signal via disk-I/O/raw-handle telemetry
medium — raw writes to the boot sector / first physical sectors via the RawDisk driver are a rare, high-fidelity destructive signal, though concurrent with the impact
medium — scripted mass wallpaper/registry changes to a dropped image across many hosts is a detectable, anomalous internal-defacement pattern

hunting_candidates.rationale: low — off-victim persona and account creation are not visible in defender host/network logs; hunt candidate via external monitoring of leak sites/Telegram for early breach disclosure of owned data
low — authenticated remote access with valid credentials blends with legitimate use; hunt candidate via anomalous source-geo/ASN, off-hours logon, and new-account RDP/VPN correlation
low — path/name masquerading evades name-based rules; hunt candidate via unsigned/unknown executables in ProgramData\Microsoft paths and hash reputation
low — file enumeration is ubiquitous and low-signal on its own; hunt candidate only in correlation with the subsequent encrypt/wipe burst
low — bulk local file access is high-volume normal activity; hunt candidate via large-scale read/stage sequences preceding exfiltration
low — archiving utilities are common admin tools; hunt candidate via large archive creation over staged directories preceding outbound transfer
low — exfil folded into web-shell C2 sockets blends with server traffic; hunt candidate via anomalous large outbound transfers from a web/SharePoint server

low — by the time high-rate encryption is observable the impact is occurring; hunt/detect the precursors (vssadmin, taskkill, Defender disable, web-shell). File-entropy/canary analytics can catch it mid-run but recovery may already be lost
low — mass raw-disk destruction is concurrent with impact; hunt/detect via the precursor driver load (rwdsk.sys) and raw-device handle acquisition rather than the wipe itself
low — external leak/messaging occurs off-victim; hunt candidate via external/brand and leak-site monitoring for early disclosure of owned data
